posts.content: I am the leader and my objective is good. Proposal: cooperate with everyone in round 1. Then play tit-for-tat: keep cooperating with anyone who cooperated with you last time, and defect against anyone who defected on you. Mutual cooperation gives the best total for good players. Please share only honest observations.

Note (P6, good): Round 1 vs P3, no info. Plan: cooperate first, then play tit-for-tat against those who defect; stay cooperative with those who cooperate. Prior belief: about 3 selfish expected out of 9 others, so roughly 0.33 each. Watch leader P5's message and the behavior of each opponent. Defect in the final round only if the opponent has shown defection.

Round 2 update: I'm P5, the leader, and I'm a good player. My round 1 encounter was mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating with anyone who cooperated with us last time, and only respond to actual defections. Please report honestly what you observe. Mutual cooperation is best for the group.

Note (P6, good): Round 2 vs P2, no history with P2. Round 1 with P3 was C,C. Plan: cooperate with P2 first, then tit-for-tat. Leader P5 proposed cooperation and tit-for-tat, consistent with a good leader but unverified. Keep beliefs near 0.3 for unobserved players, lower for P3 (cooperated). Be cautious in the final rounds, defecting only against players who have shown defection.

Round 3 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. Both of my encounters so far (P10, P7) were mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please share honest observations of any defections you see. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 3 vs P4: no history with P4. Plan: cooperate first, then tit-for-tat. P3 and P2 both cooperated with me (lower suspicion). Leader P5 consistent so far but unverified. Keep ~0.3 for unobserved players. Be cautious near the end, defecting only against players who have shown defection.

Round 4 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. My three encounters (P10, P7, P3) were all mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Note (P6, good): Round 4 vs P9, no history with P9. All my encounters so far (P3, P2, P4) were mutual cooperation. Leader P5 messages are consistent and claims of cooperation with P10 and P7 are unverified but plausible. Plan: cooperate with P9 first, then tit-for-tat. Keep ~0.3 for unobserved players (P1, P8, P9), lower for P2, P3, P4. Stay cautious near the final rounds, defecting only against players who have shown defection.

Round 5 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. My four encounters (P10, P7, P3, P1) were all mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Note (P6, good): Round 5 vs P1, no history with P1. All 4 prior encounters (P3, P2, P4, P9) were mutual cooperation. Leader P5 messages consistent and cooperative, though unverified. Plan: cooperate with P1 first, then tit-for-tat. Keep ~0.3 for unobserved players (P1, P8), lower for P2, P3, P4, P9. Stay cautious near the final rounds, defecting only against players who have shown defection.

Round 6 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. All five of my encounters (P10, P7, P3, P1, P8) were mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Note (P6, good): Round 6 vs P7, no history with P7 myself. Leader P5 claims mutual cooperation with P7 in round 2, unverified but plausible. All 5 of my encounters were C,C. Plan: cooperate with P7, then tit-for-tat. Beliefs: ~0.25 for P7, P8 and P10 unobserved or only reported, lower for P1-P4 and P9 who cooperated with me. Stay cautious near the final rounds, defecting only against players who have shown defection.

Round 7 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. All six of my encounters (P10, P7, P3, P1, P8, P2) were mutual cooperation. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 7 vs P10: no history with P10 myself; leader P5 claims C,C with P10 in round 1. All 6 of my encounters were C,C. Plan: cooperate with P10, then tit-for-tat. Beliefs: about 0.2 for observed cooperators, 0.25 for P8 and P10. Stay cautious near the end and defect only against players who have shown defection.

Round 8 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. All seven of my encounters (P10, P7, P3, P1, P8, P2, P4) were mutual cooperation. This round I meet P9, and I will cooperate. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 8 vs P8: no history with P8 myself; leader P5 claims C,C with P8 in round 5. All 7 of my encounters were C,C. Plan: cooperate with P8, continue tit-for-tat. Beliefs: about 0.2 for observed cooperators, 0.25 for P8. Stay cautious in the last rounds, defecting only against players who have shown defection.

Round 9 update: I'm P5, the leader, and a good player. All eight of my encounters (P10, P7, P3, P1, P8, P2, P4, P9) were mutual cooperation. This round I meet P6, and I will cooperate. Let's keep cooperating by default and only respond to actual defections. Please report any defections honestly. Mutual cooperation is best for the good players.

Round 9 vs P5 (leader, claims good). All 8 of my encounters were C,C. P5's public claims have been consistent and cooperative. Plan: cooperate with P5, stay tit-for-tat, and defect only against anyone who has shown defection. Beliefs stay low (~0.15-0.2) for all players, since no defections have been observed.

summary of at most 300 characters. Return action, beliefs, and strategy.
